summary: Comprehensive multi-level test suite: unit tests cover all core modules (semver, commits, changelog, versionFile, commitLog), integration tests verify end-to-end bumper flow, CLI tests validate subprocess output contract, and workflow tests verify YAML structure and actionlint compliance. Error paths are well-exercised (missing files, invalid JSON, malformed input, unknown flags). Edge cases tested include whitespace handling, 'v' prefix tolerance, breaking-change markers (both '!' and footer formats), and empty commit lists. Uses fixtures intelligently with proper temp-dir isolation. Minor gap: changelog rendering could test exact output formatting (section order, whitespace precision) more explicitly. Very solid foundation that would reliably catch most regressions.
